scope: Complete operational opening, movement, report and independent Production APK readiness without enabling writers or entering real balances.
resume: Verified prior remote checkpoint, merged PR1451, and production branch advance through print/shipping PR1452. New task branch preserves all latest production source.
changes: Add isolated acceptance runner that pins loopback replica set, disables dotenv and retains databases instead of fixture cleanup.
constraints: No live business writes, writer activation, Salla sync, legacy migration, automatic journals, database deletion or worktree deletion.
No build or dependency installation inside /app.
No change to prior frozen release intent or publication identity.
acceptance: Independent operational openings and movements conserve balances and totals; repeated requests cannot duplicate effects.
Inventory options, units, locations, costs and immutable evidence remain correct without financial journals.
Pending inventory must not become fulfillment eligible by clearing flags or pretending it is a purchase.
Advertising and shipping setup use verified native contracts, never guessed owner data.
Reports, purchases, returns and exchanges pass isolated acceptance.
APK authentication, tenant/disabled-user boundaries, installation and update remain explicit acceptance requirements.
design_question: Owner asked whether opening inventory must now also be usable for order fulfillment, or only recorded and monitored. No answer yet. Financial valuation semantics and activation are not inferred.
known_gaps: Opening inventory has no supported pending-to-adopted valuation route.
Selected advertising accounts need actual financial identities, funding and currency bindings.
Actual shipping contract evidence and effective dates require validation.
Live balances and start instant are owner inputs; no values will be invented.
next: Run scripts/run_retained_operational_acceptance.py via durable process job; inspect XML and failures, then implement the next verified gap. Keep all test databases and logs. Do not publish or activate this checkpoint.
checkpoint_sha_location: Git commit and remote branch history; no self-referential SHA is embedded.
